notes.title: 605 -to- 621 : Dan_Zoom , Zio_Blend , Muffin_Puncher
notes.content:
Mr. Muffin Man Dan wanted some zoom filters , so I made them for him .
Because Dan asked for them , they have been named in Dan's Honor .
You are welcome @#532 : M_uffin Daniel !

The display names for these new filters look ugly as sin . 
And I should fix them . I'll do that in the next update !

Filters 605 -to- 621 are all Dan inspired .

3 Categories of Dan Inspired Filters :

1. DANZOOM(s)
2. ZIOBLEND(s)
3. Muffin Punchers

-KanjiCoder
